hero.headline: Mentoring and coaching the next generation
hero.sub: Dr. Adam Weiss is a board-certified orthodontist with 32 years in the work and 8 Orthodontic/Pediatric offices. This page is not a patient clinic. The work here is mentoring residents and coaching practicing orthodontists on practice model, case reviews, contracts, and work/life.

items.title: Mentoring residents
items.text: Residents get a mentor who has already built the career they are walking into. Dr. Weiss is board-certified, 32 years in, and still running 8 Orthodontic/Pediatric offices. The mentoring is for the professional journey, not for a patient chair.

items.title: Coaching practicing orthodontists
items.text: Practicing orthodontists get coaching on the problems that start after residency: how the practice is modeled, how contracts read, how the week holds together. You are not buying a CE slide deck. You are talking to someone who still owns offices.

items.title: Practice model, cases, contracts, work/life
items.text: The named topics are practice model, case reviews, contracts, and work/life. Those four are the curriculum. Everything else is a conversation that stays inside them.

story.heading: Not a patient clinic homepage
paragraphs: People looking for braces should not use this page as a clinic. Dr. Adam Weiss built 8 Orthodontic/Pediatric offices and spent 32 years as a board-certified orthodontist. The site at orthodontists.com is for the next generation of orthodontists who want mentoring and coaching from someone who has already run the models.

Practice model, case reviews, contracts, and work/life are the four doors. A resident uses them to see the career before signing the first job. A practicing orthodontist uses them to correct a practice that is already live. Patients are not the audience.

items.title: Start as a resident or a practicing doctor
items.text: The work splits cleanly. Residents get mentoring. Practicing orthodontists get coaching. Both talk to the same board-certified doctor who still owns 8 offices.

items.title: Work the four topics
items.text: Practice model, case reviews, contracts, and work/life are the agenda. You bring the model you are considering, the case that will not sit still, the contract on the table, or the week that is eating the rest of your life.

items.title: Leave with a professional direction
items.text: The point is a clearer next move in an orthodontic career, not a patient treatment plan. Dr. Weiss has 32 years of that career to put against your question.

feature.heading: Eight offices, one mentoring practice
feature.text: The 8 Orthodontic/Pediatric offices are proof of the models, not the product being sold on this page. The product is mentoring and coaching for orthodontists who have to choose a model, read a contract, and still have a life.

spotlight.heading: Board-certified, 32 years in
spotlight.text: The credentials matter because the advice is coming from a working owner, not a consultant who left the chair. Dr. Adam Weiss is board-certified and still in the work he is teaching.
